name: read
description: Read a text file. offset is a 1-based line number. Output is bounded; read larger datasets with Python if needed.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the current output directory.

name: write
description: Write UTF-8 text to a file, creating parent directories. Existing contents are replaced. External writes require approval. Write scripts and reports using this tool.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the current output directory.

name: edit
description: Replace exactly one occurrence of oldText in a UTF-8 file with newText. Fails without changes if oldText is absent or ambiguous.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the current output directory.

name: bash
description: Execute bash in the current output directory. python/python3, rg and fd use bundled versions. No user shell startup files. No installing dependencies. Common dangerous operations are blocked; external writes, detected networking and dynamic execution request approval. Default timeout 180 seconds.

name: grep
description: Search text using ripgrep regex. Output and file count are bounded. Hidden/sensitive files and directory symlinks are excluded from recursive search.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the current output directory.

name: find
description: Find regular files using an fd filename regex. Hidden/sensitive paths are excluded. Up to 256 matches.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the current output directory.

name: ls
description: List up to 500 directory entries, showing file, directory or symlink type.

path.description: Absolute path or path relative to the current output directory.

name: ask_clarification
description: Ask a concise clarification question and wait for an answer. This is not a permission approval and cannot authorize filesystem/network operations.
